messages.text:
I’ve proposed BRL 119.00 for the returned metal rack. The amount is based on what you paid for the item; shipping isn’t included, and I can’t add or relabel the delivery charge as the item’s price. (refund-policy/v2/amount)

To proceed with the rack refund, confirm the exact proposal using the button on its card. A chat message won’t confirm it. (refund-policy/v2/approval)

Shipping charges aren’t refunded automatically. Since you asked for the delivery charge back, a staff member must review it. (refund-policy/v2/shipping)
